newsitem.title: CENTRAL AFRICAN REPUBLIC: Central African president returns home amid mutiny.
newsitem.headline: Central African president returns home amid mutiny.

text.p: Central African Republic President Ange-Felix Patasse returned home on Monday despite a pledge by army mutineers to oust him, loyalist sources said.

They said Patasse, who was in Europe when the revolt started on November 16, flew home after a stopover in Gabon. French troops based in the capital Bangui have been patrolling the city and control access to the airport, making it impossible to check on the atmosphere at the president's arrival.
Rebel soldiers on Monday demanded Patasse's dismissal, saying he should not return from an official visit to France.
